meta.name: self-updating-wiki
meta.description: Keep the NodeRoom agent wiki synchronized with room artifacts, upload references, public chat, traces, and agent run evidence. Use when updating the in-app wiki, docs/AGENT_WIKI.md, interview documentation, or any agent-generated table-of-contents page after file uploads, research updates, finance spreadsheet edits, trace changes, or agent workflow changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动同步房间制品到知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将聊天记录、文件等同步到团队知识库
copy.tagline_en: Auto-sync room artifacts to the wiki
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to sync chat logs, files, etc. to the team wiki

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动维护一个房间可见的维基页面，根据房间内的文件、聊天记录和操作痕迹更新内容，并保持固定的目录结构。
howto.when: 当房间内有文件上传、聊天消息包含文件引用、研究数据更新、电子表格编辑、代理运行完成或用户将私密笔记公开时触发。

say.text: 更新维基，加入我刚上传的财务表格。
把这次代理运行的痕迹加到维基的 Recent trace 里。
say.note: Claude 会读取最新 trace 并追加摘要。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically maintains a room-visible wiki page that updates based on files, chat messages, and trace events in the room, keeping a fixed table of contents.
howto.when_en: Triggered by file uploads, chat messages with file references, research updates, spreadsheet edits, agent run completions, or when a user promotes a private note to public chat.

say_en.text: Update the wiki with the finance spreadsheet I just uploaded.
say_en.note: Claude reads the new file and refreshes the Files and Workflows sections.

say_en.text: Add the latest agent run trace to the Recent trace section.
say_en.note: Claude reads recent trace entries and appends a summary.
